name: Releasetrain.io
description: Developed and trained an ML/NLP model for automated update-path risk detection used in the Releasetrain.io dashboard.
Created labelling guidelines and annotated 4,000+ web-scraped Reddit samples to support ML model training.
Performed hyperparameter tuning on the ML model, achieving 97% accuracy and a 67% F1-score.

name: Sproutly
description: Built dashboard for an IoT watering system enabling real-time monitoring and 15-minute automated updates.
Led a 4-member team to design frontend architecture and deliver a functional prototype in 3 months.
Containerized the app using Docker to streamline deployment and ensure environment consistency.

name: Emergency Service Provisioning for IOV
description: Utilized SUMO simulation for implementing the Deep-Q-network responsible for automation of emergency vehicle, aiming to reduce emergency response time.
Reduced emergency response time from 289 ms to 275 ms (~4.8% improvement) across training episodes.
Outperformed rule-based baselines (Heuristic & MOBIL) with ~7–8% lower latency, demonstrating the effectiveness of adaptive RL-driven vehicle communication.
